items.docs: Start a background AI agent on a Flint site. Two task types are supported: a free-form `prompt` task that instructs the agent to modify the site, and a `generate_pages` task that creates multiple pages from a template page and a list of items. Returns a taskId to poll or a callbackUrl is invoked on completion.

params.name: taskId
params.description: The task identifier returned by createAgentTask.

items.docs: Retrieve the status of a previously created agent task. While running, returns status only. On completion, returns an output object listing the pages created, modified, and deleted. On failure, returns an errorMessage.
